method: ServUO pub57 Scripts/Services, Items, Mobiles; a file is a candidate when its stem is not in tools/modernuo-stems.txt; done when the stem exists anywhere under server/customizations. Each candidate goes to the FIRST system whose prefix matches (order matters). Quests/, Skills/, Spells/ not scanned yet.

tiers.port: worth porting now; counts toward the target
tiers.decide: waits on Chase; counts once decided
tiers.ride: ported only with the system that uses it; not counted
tiers.reward: stock for loot boxes, League shop, recipe rewards; ported on demand; not counted
tiers.source: design source; our own system replaces it; never counted
tiers.later: fits the shard, deliberately not now; not counted
tiers.drop: no longer fits the shard's direction; not counted

systems.title: Bulk orders, all crafts
systems.why: F-18, F-20, F-25, F-37: BODs for every craft skill; ServUO's 2016 revamp is the named port source

systems.title: Treasure maps revamp
systems.why: F-20 Cartography (explore and map) and the gain path to 200; OSI has the answer
systems.feeds: F-20; gate: train without a wall

systems.title: Monster stealing
systems.why: Stealing's gain path past the stock ceiling (D82 area); OSI has the answer

systems.title: Despise and Shame (revamped)
systems.why: ported and client-checked (CC4); kept on the list so the target counts what is done

systems.title: Blackthorn Dungeon (revamped)
systems.why: 'Somewhere to go' gate, League dungeon dives (F-24), dungeon chests (F-32)
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go; F-24, F-32

systems.title: Covetous Void Spawn
systems.why: same as above; Void creatures feed monster parts
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go; F-24, F-32

systems.title: Wrong (revamped)
systems.why: same as above
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go; F-24, F-32

systems.title: The Exodus Encounter
systems.why: same; boss content for loot boxes (boss kills roll boxes, F-40)
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go; F-40 boss boxes

systems.title: Underworld (Stygian Abyss) + mini champions
systems.why: a dungeon open to every race; puzzles fit the snark; mini champs feed League culling
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go; F-24 culling

systems.title: Creatures: Mobiles/Normal remainder, bosses, Void creatures, AI
systems.why: 'Things to fight' gate (19 spawn orphans), League hunts and culling, monster parts for imbuing and epic crafting; WoW/Diablo art lands on these, renamed
systems.feeds: gate: things to fight; F-24, F-40, F-42

systems.title: Pet Training (OSI animal training)
systems.why: 132 ServUO creature files call it; Animal Lore past its ceiling needs high-level tameables. Decided 2026-10-13 (Chase): port it fully; evo pets and companions sit on top of OSI animal training, they do not replace it
systems.feeds: F-35 evo pets, companions, Animal Lore to 200

systems.title: Eodon (Time of Legends) remainder, no Myrmidex or Shadowguard
systems.why: a whole facet of places and dinosaurs, half already ported (CC3)
systems.feeds: gate: somewhere to go, things to fight

systems.title: High Seas, fishing half
systems.why: F-20 Fishing deeds, Maritime Brotherhood (Fishing, Cooking), fish and lobster traps, profession fish quests, sea champions

systems.title: Crafting gaps: basket weaving, armor refinement, craft helpers, raised gardens
systems.why: recipe gating (F-43) needs the stock OSI recipes present to gate; raised gardens and potted plants feed Herbalism

systems.title: Food, drink and potions
systems.why: Cooking (Maritime) and the Order of the Alembic need OSI's consumables to have anything to make and gate

systems.title: Base items: resources, equipment, containers, tools, functional
systems.why: the plain remainder a ported system reaches for; trap training kits are Lockpicking and Remove Trap gain paths

systems.title: Reward pool: addons, decorative, store items, artifact remainder, Clean Up rewards
systems.why: stock for loot boxes (F-40), the League shop (F-13), recipe and commission rewards; ported on demand, not counted

systems.title: Design source only, ours replaces
systems.why: Imbuing (P82 Artificers), Runic Reforging (F-42 epic crafting), Huntmaster (F-24 hunts), PointsSystems (P33), XmlSpawner (P32 importer; P72 'the design, not the code'), Town Cryer (F-15, P64), ML quest framework (declined twice)

systems.title: Later, deliberately
systems.why: seasonal events (with the F-30 Events tab: Forsaken Foes, Krampus, the Treasures of ... events, Rising Tide), Shadowguard, Tomb of Kings and Ter Mur (races last), Instanced Peerless and Peerless, Astronomy, Fortune's Fire, High Seas naval (C7, proposal only), champion and Doom extras

systems.title: Dropped: no longer fits
systems.why: account and staff tokens (name, race, gender change; GM tools; bless and pardon deeds) and PvP and faction systems (Vice vs Virtue, Factions, PvP Arena, Myrmidex Invasion), player-economy systems for a two-player shard (New Magincia bazaar and lotto, Vendor Searching, City Loyalty, AuctionSafe), the paid store shell (no donations), Exploring the Deep (worst ratio on the menu), staff/engine plumbing ModernUO already has (Reports, RemoteAdmin, Pathing, Chat, Party, Help, Ethics, Spawner, GiftGiving, Loyalty)

systems.title: Ride-along: NPCs, quest items, books, internals
systems.why: ported with the system that uses them, never on their own; not counted

decided.what: Pet Training moved from decide to port, placed right after Creatures (it unblocks about 40% of that row). No decide tier is left.
Direction: a faithful port comes first, our feature customizations after it. Work already started or already requested still gets finished.

covers: cc-P136: a system's covers lists the progress-state.json task ids whose work it now counts; progress.py shows such a task as covered by it and leaves it out of the task totals. C2-C7 and S7 per P92's note.
